title: Emerging Profit-Pool Candidate Second Replication Plan
rationale: Repository experiments exist for 2019Q3-Q4 but no matching v3.2/profit-pool training artifacts were found for 2019H1. Freeze H1 as the second replication window before revealing the 2017 holdout.
rules: Use the same broad professional/generalist hub-first discovery architecture.
Assign profit-pool labels before price outcomes.
Do not use 2019Q3-Q4 artifacts or known winners to construct the H1 universe.
Do not alter the emerging-pool definition or label states after the 2017 result.
Production adoption requires evidence across both holdouts, not one successful example.
